newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait gives justice ministry to cabinet minister.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait gives justice ministry to cabinet minister.

text.p: Kuwait has temporarily given the justice portfolio to its Minister of State for Cabinet Affairs Abdul-Aziz al-Dakhil, a decree said on Saturday.

Former justice minister Mishari al-Anjari was one of four ministers who resigned earlier this month to comply with a law barring civil servants and ministers from standing for parliament. The four are elected members of parliament.
An official on September 4 erroneously told Reuters the justice portfolio was given to Minister of Interior Sheikh Ali Sabah al-Salem al-Sabah.
The oil and education portfolios were transferred to Information Minister Sheikh Saud Nasser al-Saud al-Sabah. The labour portfolio was given to Sheikh Ali.
The government has announced parliamentary polls would be held on October 7 in the second race since the 1991 Gulf War for the only elected legislature on the Arab side of the Gulf.
The fortunes of the 50-seat chamber are watched closely around the Gulf by liberals who see it as a potential model for other states in the region in generations to come.
A new cabinet will be announced soon after the elections.
